checked.found: Abu Bakr chosen as first caliph in 632 after Muhammad's death.
Britannica and most sources date Nahavand to 642 under Caliph Umar; 641 appears only for the army's assembly.
Battle of the Camel, 656, Ali vs Aisha's army near Basra, start of the First Fitna.
Construction began under al-Walid I about 706.
Abd al-Rahman III declared himself caliph in 929; Abbasid and Fatimid caliphates already existed.
Construction of Madinat al-Zahra began 936 under Abd al-Rahman III; some sources give 936-940 for the span.
Buyids under Mu'izz al-Dawla entered Baghdad in 945, reducing the Abbasid caliph to a figurehead.
Fatimid caliphate ended in 1171 when Saladin restored the Abbasid khutba; name is 34 characters.
Khilafat Movement began 1919 (span 1919-1924); description names no date.
